_about: This week's starting QB for every FBS team playing, checked on every daily run (WEEKLY_PROMPT.md step 7e). scripts/build_data.py uses it for the game header (this week and later unplayed weeks) and the EPA page, only while 'week' matches the build's current week. status: confirmed / reported (a change from the last game's starter), uncertain (open question; the listed QB is the default and the note names the alternative), no change.
